title: The adopt_named held guard stops panel names from correcting a swapped automatic display pair
source: Introduced by aca2f26 (PR #125); fixed in f877ee3 with tests for a swapped automatic pair.

expected.what: The held check treats a texture as blocked whenever another side holds it, even when that side holds it only as an automatic guess. A detected pair {6,5} with names {5,6} leaves both sides held, so names never fix swapped captain and first-officer displays.

evidence: Before the change adopt_named reassigned every side the user had not chosen. The held loop meant to protect a texture the user moved does not check whether the holder's assignment is the user's. The fix counts a texture as held only when a user-chosen side holds it.
